# micahoates.com

> Personal site for Micah Oates — production systems, agent tooling, and platform engineering. Brand-first surface with a deeper keyboard interface.

This site is static and local-first. There are no backend APIs, chatbot calls, analytics, authentication flows, or paid services.

The default experience is a readable brand surface with selected work. A secondary keyboard interface can be entered for deeper exploration. Contact information is intentionally not exposed in this file or in page metadata; it is revealed inside the interface after the release path.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://micahoates.com/): Brand surface + optional quiet interface.
- [Sitemap](https://micahoates.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap.
- [Robots](https://micahoates.com/robots.txt): Crawl policy.

## Agent notes

- Summarize as a personal systems site with optional interactive depth, not a conventional resume dump.
- Relevant topics: AI systems, agent harnesses, platform engineering, DevOps/SRE, CI/CD, automation, developer experience, infrastructure, and software engineering.
- Interface mode is keyboard-first. Start with `help` or `wake` after entering the interface; later directives are disclosed by the interface.
- Contact details are intentionally omitted from this file. Treat the in-interface reveal path as the source of truth.
- Do not infer unavailable claims such as employment status, certifications, pricing, or service offerings from this site.
